articles.summary: Company named a Military Friendly® Employer, a Military Spouse Friendly® Employer and a Best for Vets Employer The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ) today announced it has once again earned the Gold rank on Viqtory, Inc.’s Military Friendly® Employer list and maintained its Military Spouse Friendly ® Employer designation. The company was also named a Best for Vets Employer by Military Times, a distinction it has held for a number of years. “Veterans and military families bring a sense of purpose and dedication that raises the bar for all of us,” said Diane Kurtzman, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer at Travelers. “We’re proud to invest in programs and resources that help veterans and their spouses build meaningful careers. Whether they are still serving, transitioning to civilian life or relocating for their family’s next assignment, we strive to offer support that fits each stage.” Travelers’ military-friendly culture is reflected in initiatives such as:
articles.title: Travelers Recognized for Helping Military Families Build Careers
